cost: Prediction scans words per token and position per word: O(W²+T*W) plus string/map work; compose bounded depth2. diff/apply O(K log K) keyed pairs; Learn next-UPOS linear searches can be quadratic. Lexicon decoding affix suffix totals O(U*S).
description: predict chooses given/exact/bare/compose/segment/unknown analyses, emits ranges and numbered words, derives Ref/MId, uses inner head or next-UPOS then generic offset. diff stores fields or canonical keyed patches; apply sorts keys. Learn tallies analyses/offsets before chunk-cut validation, chooses BTree lexical/offset tie winner, derives affix summaries. write/read serializes core lexicon and recomputes affixes.
forward: predict chooses given/exact/bare/compose/segment/unknown analyses, emits ranges and numbered words, derives Ref/MId, uses inner head or next-UPOS then generic offset. diff stores fields or canonical keyed patches; apply sorts keys. Learn tallies analyses/offsets before chunk-cut validation, chooses BTree lexical/offset tie winner, derives affix summaries. write/read serializes core lexicon and recomputes affixes.
inverse: Given analysis outranks lexicon; unknown token does not acquire a known lemma. External heads clamp but inner heads need not. Noncanonical MISC uses whole field. Lexicon text codec does not preserve arbitrary derived caches or counts.

For fixed pred and admitted target fields, apply(diff(pred,lit)) recovers lit; target alone permits many predictions and patches. bare removes accents so fiber contains accent variants. read(write(lex)) reconstructs core records only under delimiter/nonempty restrictions; derived fields recomputed, training counts lost.
limitations: Partial source syntax and finite pure-code tests only; no model loading, live corpus/site/lesson workflows, full pipeline or persistent learning claim.
No executable percentage surrogate or semantic proof; explicit codec domains and resource limits apply.
state: Ten fields per row; unique canonical FEATS/MISC keys for pair identity, '_' empty convention, delimiter-free nonempty analyses for serialization. Finite counts/products/indices, signed offsets avoiding overflow; supplied lexicon only, no global load.
